Saci Perere
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 11:37am

Ingredients




cup Cachac,a
3 tablespoons Honey (may adjust to taste)
Juice of one lime

Preparation

1 NOTES : Saci Perere is a mythical one legged dwarf of the Brazilian Folklore. This drink is actually taken as Flu Medicine. Mix all the ingrdients in asauce pan over low heat. Stir ubtil warm. Serve warm in a cup.
